While kinase activity (GO:0016301) is not wrong, a more informative term is available. Martin et al. reported azido-ATP labeling of GroES Tyr71, so the electronic mapping has a primary-paper provenance. However, ATP/ADP binding in productive GroEL-GroES structures is assigned to the GroEL rings, and UniProt does not curate a nucleotide-binding feature on E. coli GroES.
